skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply advanced microeconomic theories and models to analyze real-world economic issues.
Analyze and evaluate economic behavior of consumers, firms, and governments under resource scarcity.
Conduct independent and group research, synthesizing and presenting economic information.
Develop critical thinking skills to assess economic theories and models.
Work effectively in teams to solve economic problems.
Deliver clear and structured presentations on economic topics.
Demonstrate self-learning and research capabilities in economic studies.
Apply problem-solving techniques to economic scenarios.
Use mathematical tools to analyze economic models and theories.
Construct and interpret economic models to understand market dynamics.
Analyze the impact of economic policies on market outcomes.
Make informed decisions based on economic theories and data.
Analyze market structures and competitive behaviors.
Understand and manage economic risks in decision-making processes.
Analyze public goods and externalities in economic contexts.
Understand and address issues of information asymmetry in economic transactions.
